slides.title: Let's Go!
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 1 English, Unit 7: Let's Go! In this unit you will learn how we travel and get around. You will meet the words for ways to travel — walk, bus, car, bicycle and boat — and learn to say how you go to school. You will talk about journeys: going somewhere with the people you love, staying safe, and enjoying the trip. Say the words out loud — this is about confident everyday English, not perfect spelling. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Name common ways to travel (walk, bus, car, bicycle, boat, train, plane).
Say how you get to school: “I go to school by ___.”
Say the action words for travel (drive, ride, fly, float, walk).
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to name common ways to travel (walk, bus, car, bicycle, boat, train, plane). You will also say how you get to school: “I go to school by ___.” You will also say the action words for travel (drive, ride, fly, float, walk). Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: long, sing, ring, king, song, thin. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes Amal's Big Bus Ride and Talk about Let's Go!. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: Say how you travel
bullets: Tell us how you get to school each morning. Say the way you travel after the word 'by'.
Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is Say how you travel. Tell us how you get to school each morning. Say the way you travel after the word 'by'. Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 - Listen and point. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
